signal_chain_review.note: 2026-11-15 design-review estimate; all inputs are assumptions to be replaced by bench data. Not part of the R5-PDR1 released budget.
signal_chain_review.pmt_gain_note: Hamamatsu H10720/H10721 datasheet TPMO1062E (read 2026-11-16): recommended control voltage 0.5-1.1 V, typical gain curve about 5e3 at 0.5 V and about 2e6 at 1.0 V; -20 anode radiant sensitivity 1.5e5 A/W at 1.0 V, cathode 78 mA/W at 630 nm; max average output current 100 uA. gain_example 1000 lies below the recommended range, so variants with pmt_gain 5000 are the realistic ones until Hamamatsu confirms lower settings.
signal_chain_review.noise_floor_note: Density-independent floor (film grain, laser noise) added in quadrature. OEM shows 0.008 at D0.95-1.4 per 45um pixel; Microtek 4.5D mode measured 0.0045 at D0.95 and 0.0053 at D1.4 (42um pixel, lateral correlation 0.7), so 0.005 is used. Assumption for a 50um pixel.

microtek_measured.note: Measured 2026-11-16 from Microtek 4.5D-mode scan of the same ASTM film (600 dpi = 42um pixel), median of 4 strips (H3,H4,V3,V4; the other four strips were mis-registered), per-pixel sigma. Noise is laterally correlated (r~0.7, resampled or low-passed), so effective photoelectron counts derived from it are an upper bound. Modes 3.5D/4.0D at D3.87: 0.035/0.021; at D4.39: 0.074/0.043. Step 13 has 0.2-0.7% zero pixels. See engineering/中晶实测噪声_ASTM片.csv.

oem_measured.note: Measured 2026-11-16 from OEM-ASTM.dcm (EDAYUNFEI, 45um pixel, ASTM E1936 film A0582), median of 8 step strips, per-pixel sigma after plane detrend. Densities are the certificate mean over strips A-H. D4.39 omitted: zero clipping up to 29% and position-dependent dark floor. See engineering/OEM实测噪声_ASTM片.csv.

collector_guide_r52.status: R5.2 proposed baseline replacing the R5 taper rod C06 (8x10 -> 5.2x5.2, L32, 0.4 air gap). Monte-Carlo screened only; not measured; OEM acrylic plate not yet measured.
collector_guide_r52.type: trapezoid PMMA plate, total internal reflection, input edge along the scan direction
collector_guide_r52.material: cast optical-grade PMMA, annealed after machining; all six faces optically polished
collector_guide_r52.output_coupling: optical silicone pad 0.35 mm (index matched) to the PMT window; no air gap

layout_fix_b.note: With the 48 mm plate B01 keeps its 50 mm height and clears film sensors S03 in Y; only the two upper B01 posts move down 5 mm and the shield H01 gets two local step-downs to z96 behind the board at the sensors.

collector_guide_r52.mc_note: engineering/导光件方案对比_蒙特卡洛.csv, 150000 rays per position, statistical error about 1-2 %; L50 gave 0.0445 / 2.2 %; collection drops to 0.028 if an air gap is left at the PMT end.
collector_guide_r52.open_layout_items: Interference rerun 2026-11-16 with the 48 mm plate (tests/cad_overlap_R52_A.json, _B.json): plain shift gives 3 overlaps with film sensors S03; with layout_fix_b 0 overlaps in the R5 core and 0 against the G3 four-roller parts. Tight nominal clearances: B01 to S03 0.8 mm, shield step-down to S03 2.0 mm, shroud to entry lower roller 2.3 mm. Stiffness of the shell with the 100 mm side slot not checked.
